definitions.gloss: homicide; being killed by another person
definitions.explanation: Death caused by another person, as opposed to suicide or natural causes. Used primarily in forensic, legal, and news contexts when classifying a cause of death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{他殺|たさつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The police are investigating the possibility of homicide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{他殺|たさつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{断定|だんてい}→断定：04519_dantei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cause of death was determined to be homicide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}られていた→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{司法|しほう}{解剖|かいぼう}→司法解剖：25185_shihoukaibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{他殺|たさつ}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was initially thought to be suicide, but the autopsy revealed it was homicide.

notes:
A forensic and legal term used to classify death as having been caused by another person. It contrasts with ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧ (suicide), ⟦{事故死|じこし}→事故死：23678_jikoshi⟧ (accidental death), and ⟦{病死|びょうし}→病死：22006_byoushi⟧ (death by illness).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他殺|たさつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧: suspicion of homicide
- {他殺|たさつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{断定|だんてい}→断定：04519_dantei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to determine as homicide
- {他殺|たさつ}⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧: body of a homicide victim

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧: murder — focuses on the criminal act
- ⟦{殺害|さつがい}→殺害：13226_satsugai⟧: killing — the act of killing someone
- ⟦{自殺|じさつ}→自殺：03336_jisatsu⟧: suicide — death by one's own hand (opposite concept)

FORMS:
⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧ (other person) + {殺|さつ} (killing). Literally 'killing by another.'
